'''Mounted terrorbird gnomes''' are [[gnomes]] riding [[terrorbird]]s. They are stronger than regular unmounted terrorbirds. They are found spread around and to the south of the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]] and the [[Battlefield]]. They may be killed for the [[bird (disambiguation)|bird]] [[slayer assignment]]. They attack with melee and are weak for their level, and consequently aren't very hard to kill.
